# Placement fixtures

Real inputs for `/api/sponsor/place` (`src/services/placement.test.ts`,
`src/utils/episodePlacement.test.ts`, `src/services/anime/animeSynonyms.test.ts`).
Nothing here is hand-written; fields placement does not read are left out of recorded
answers, and every value kept is as received.

| File                                   | Source                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Why it is here                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `releases.json`                        | 33 releases of the rex library on fun (2026-10-16: the row's `_release`, `_folder`, file name and the IMDb id zurg pushed), and rex's `tests/fixtures/anime/releases.json` and `batch_files.json` with the show's IMDb id                                                    | Each case's `expect` is DMM's answer, checked against rex's placement (`rex`). Where they differ, TMDB's own season list decides: One Piece `- 0423` is TMDB's S13E423 (rex: S1E423, which TMDB does not list), Medabots' `06 - The Gimme Ghost` is TMDB's S1E7 "The Gimme Ghost", Ace of Diamond Act II S2 is TMDB's season 4. |
| `answers.json`                         | Every provider answer those releases needed: TMDB's find, show details and season lists through DMM's `/api/metadata` (`?sources=tmdb`), `imdb_title_episode` and `Anime` rows from dmmdb, the Fribb dataset (2026-10-16), manami's anime-offline-database (release 2026-27) | The Fribb entries are those of every show placement looked at and every title it looked up, with all their names, so the index answers each lookup as the full one does. `identify` holds DMM's `/api/sponsor/identify` answers for the names that needed one.                                                                  |
| `pack-folders.json`                    | rex `tests/fixtures/identify/pack_folders.json`: every video file of eight multi-season packs on fun's providers, numbers read by hand                                                                                                                                       | `Stagione 6/01 Zod`, `Season 6/601 - …`, `S1 (2007-9)/101a-b - …`, `Saturday Night Live Seasons 1-15/Season 12/17 John Larroquette, Timbuk 3`: numbered only beside their folder.                                                                                                                                               |
| `unplaced-episodes.json`               | rex `tests/fixtures/identify/unplaced_episodes.json`: files rex's production feed left unplaced or misplaced (2026-10-13..16), numbers read by hand                                                                                                                          | `Tower of God S2 - 07v2` lost its season to a `S2 - 07` range misread, `[0x539]` read as season 0 episode 539, `1920x816` as a year season, `aaf-wilty.302` in `…S03E01` as episode 302.                                                                                                                                        |
| `anime-offline-database-excerpt.jsonl` | Three lines of manami's anime-offline-database, release 2026-27                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Gintama, `Gintama°: Aizome Kaori-hen` (synonym `Gintama: Love Potion Arc`) and `Hajime no Ippo: The Fighting! - New Challenger` (synonym `Hajime no Ippo: New Challenger`): release names the `Anime` table's AniDB titles do not carry.                                                                                        |
